STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Original author statistics

The following pages retain the names, numerical values and abilities from the author's original stat blocks, with layout normalised. They are reference text, not imported Actors. Apparent arithmetic errors, missing formulas and ambiguous actions are intentionally not silently corrected. See @UUID[Compendium.stillroots-song-journals.gm-journals.JournalEntry.1abafce5d3fc121a]{Mechanical audit and proposed rulings} before running the true creatures.

These blocks are not a certification of their stated challenge ratings. All three hags plus mounts are outside the intended default level-10 encounter. Use @UUID[Compendium.stillroots-song-journals.gm-journals.JournalEntry.0372dd61e62dfc2b]{the ritual manifestation} for the one-shot, or explicitly choose a different high-power campaign encounter.

No original Gargantua stat block was supplied. Its rider interaction is preserved; no tarrasque statistics have been invented to fill the gap.

STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Babha Yagha, Grandma, The Malevolent Matriarch

Large Fiend (Hag), chaotic evil

Armor Class 17 (natural armor). Hit Points 330 (40d10 + 120). Speed 30 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
18 (+4) 16 (+3) 16 (+3) 22 (+6) 18 (+4) 24 (+7)

Saving Throws: Str +10, Dex +9, Con +9, Int +10, Wis +10, Cha +13.

Skills: Arcana +12, Deception +10, Insight +12, Intimidation +10, Nature +12, Perception +12, Stealth +11.

Damage Resistance: Necrotic; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks Not Made With Silvered Weapon.

Damage Immunities: cold, fire, poison. Condition Immunities: charmed, frightened, poisoned.

Senses: darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 22. Languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Sylvan, telepathy 120 ft. Challenge: 22.

Innate Spellcasting. Charisma (spell save DC 22), no material components. At will: disguise self, detect magic, mage hand, minor illusion. 1/day each: baleful polymorph, feeblemind, power word stun.

Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If Babha Yagha fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance. Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Magic Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical.

Regeneration. Regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point.

Actions

Multiattack. Babha Yagha can use her Frightening Gaze and then make two claw attacks.

Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

Frightening Gaze. One creature she can see within 30 feet. If the target can see her, it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each turn, ending on success. Success or ending the effect grants immunity to her Frightening Gaze for 24 hours.

Soul Steal. Babha Yagha attempts to steal the soul of a creature she can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma save or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. Reduction lasts until a long rest. The target dies if its maximum becomes 0. Source omission: no damage amount was specified.

Summon Darklings (1/Day). Summons 2d4 Darklings within 60 feet. They act immediately, rolling their own initiative. They remain for 1 hour or until dismissed as a bonus action.

Legendary actions

Three per round; one option at the end of another creature's turn; refresh at the start of her turn.

Cackle (1). All creatures within 30 feet make a DC 21 Wisdom save or become frightened of her for 1 minute.

Summon Servants (2). Summons 1d4 + 1 darklings, berbalangs, or other creatures of her choice to an unoccupied space within 30 feet.

Rotting Curse (3). One creature within 60 feet makes a DC 21 Constitution save. Failure: 8d8 necrotic damage and ages 1d6 x 10 years. Success: half damage, no aging. If beyond the average lifespan of its race, another DC 21 Constitution save; failure means death of old age. The effect can only be removed by Remove Curse or similar magic.

Mounted

One with the Cauldron. +5 AC while riding her cauldron. She can use its abilities while riding it, including levitation or boiling-hot liquid attacks.

text.content:
STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Babha Yagha's Cauldron

Huge construct, unaligned

AC 18 (natural armor). HP 200 (16d10 + 96). Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (hover).

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
20 (+5) 14 (+2) 20 (+5) 1 (-5) 10 (+0) 1 (-5)

Damage Immunities: Poison, Psychic. Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned.

Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Languages: understands its creator's languages but cannot speak. Challenge: 9 (5,000 XP).

Immutable Form. Immune to spells or effects that alter its form.

Magic Resistance. Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Magic Weapons. Weapon attacks are magical.

Actions and movement traits as supplied

Slam. Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

Spit Acid. Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) acid damage.

Hover. Can hover in place if it takes the Dash action.

Flyby. Does not provoke opportunity attacks when flying out of an enemy's reach.

Audit note: the source lists hover both in speed and as a Dash-dependent property; choose one interpretation before use. No Cauldron Leap attack has been added.

text.content:
STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Babha Yagha's Hut

Gargantuan construct, unaligned

AC 20 (natural armor). HP 300 (24d10 + 144). Speed 60 ft., fly 90 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
20 (+5) 10 (+0) 20 (+5) 1 (-5) 3 (-4) 1 (-5)

Damage Immunities: Poison, Psychic. Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned.

Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16. Languages: understands its creator's languages but cannot speak. Challenge: 16 (15,000 XP).

Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. Magic Weapons. Weapon attacks are magical.

False Appearance. While motionless, indistinguishable from a normal hut.

Siege Monster. Double damage to objects and structures.

Actions

Slam. Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

Teleport (1/day). Magically teleports itself and any creatures within 120 feet of it to a location up to 10 miles away. The destination must be a place the hut has visited or can see or visualise in its mind. It can bring objects within its carrying capacity. It may use this to escape or move to a desired location.

Legendary actions

Three per round, at the end of other creatures' turns, refreshed at the start of its turn.

Slam Attack (1). Makes one slam attack.

Chicken Run (1). Moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Preservation note: Teleport remains an action, 1/day, with the supplied 10-mile range. A later draft's 1-mile legendary-action rewrite, Stomp and Consume are not part of this source block.

STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Mama Yagha, The Venomous Fang

Large Fiend (Hag), chaotic evil

AC 17 (natural armor). HP 330 (40d10 + 120). Speed 30 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
22 (+6) 18 (+4) 20 (+5) 18 (+4) 14 (+2) 20 (+5)

Saves: Str +12, Dex +9, Con +10, Int +8, Wis +7, Cha +10.

Skills: Arcana +8, Deception +11, Perception +9, Stealth +9.

Damage Resistance: Cold, Fire; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks Not Made With Silvered Weapon.

Damage Immunity: Poison. Condition Immunities: Charmed, Poisoned.

Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19. Languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, Yuan-ti. Challenge: 15.

Innate Spellcasting. Charisma, spell save DC 19; no material components. At will: darkness, detect magic, detect poison and disease, shield, suggestion. 3/day each: contagion, dominate person, lightning bolt, poison spray, wall of fire. 1/day each: cloudkill, finger of death, power word kill.

Rejuvenation. When slain she reverts to snake form and turns to stone until the next dawn, when she regains all HP and returns to hag form.

Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a giant snake or back to her yuan-ti/hag hybrid form. Statistics remain the same, but she cannot use claws or bite in snake form. This unusual source restriction is retained.

Snake Hair. Any creature starting its turn within 5 feet makes a DC 19 Constitution save: 21 (6d6) poison damage on failure, half on success.

Spell Resistance. Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions

Multiattack. Two claws, or one bite and one claw.

Claws. Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

Summon Snakes (1/day). Summons a loyal unit of Yuan-ti within 60 feet, lasting 1 minute or until she dismisses it as an action. Hostile to creatures other than Mama and allies. Source omission: unit composition/number is not specified.

Legendary actions

Three per round; refresh at the start of her turn. Options without a stated cost use the source's implicit one-action cost, pending GM confirmation.

Venomous Bite. Melee fang attack; on hit 2d6 + 4 piercing, then DC 17 Constitution save for 21 (6d6) poison on failure, half poison on success. Attack bonus/reach not stated here.

Serpentine Coils. Moves up to her speed without opportunity attacks, through spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each passed-through creature makes DC 17 Dexterity save or takes 2d8 + 4 bludgeoning and falls prone.

Yuan-ti Magic. Casts a known spell with casting time 1 action, one target, range touch; examples given are inflict wounds or bestow curse. Those examples are not on her supplied spell list.

Snake Hair. Up to three targets within 30 feet make DC 17 Dexterity saves or take 2d8 + 4 piercing damage and become poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn.

Recharge Innate Magic (2). Roll d6; on 5-6 regain a spell slot or renew a spell slot for an ally. Source uses slots despite innate per-day uses.

Mounted

One with the Serpent. +2 AC while riding Valdershmort; can use the basilisk's abilities while riding it.

Regeneration. While Mama rides it, the basilisk regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 HP.

STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Valdershmort

Huge monstrosity, unaligned

AC 18 (natural armor). HP 325 (23d12 + 161). Speed 50 ft., swim 50 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
20 (+5) 10 (+0) 20 (+5) 1 (-5) Score missing; modifier (-4) supplied 1 (-5)

Saves: Str +12, Con +13. Damage Immunities: Poison, Psychic. Condition Immunities: Petrified, Poisoned. Skill: Stealth +4.

Senses: darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Languages: none. Challenge: 14.

Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell.

Petrifying Gaze. A creature starting its turn within 30 feet, where both it and the basilisk can see each other, can be forced to make a DC 18 Constitution save if the basilisk is not incapacitated. Failure starts petrification and Restrained. Repeat the save at the end of its next turn: success ends the effect, failure means Petrified until Greater Restoration or other magic. A creature not surprised may avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save; it cannot then see the basilisk until its next turn. Looking at it in the meantime immediately calls for the save.

Actions

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 feet; 22 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 12d6 poison on a failed DC 20 Constitution save, or half as much poison on success.

Poison Breath (recharge 5-6). A 60-foot cone; DC 20 Constitution save: 77 (22d6) poison damage on failure, half on success.

Legendary actions

Three per round, at other creatures' turn ends; refresh on its turn.

Move (1). Up to half speed.

Bite (2). Makes a bite attack.

Petrifying Gaze (3). Uses Petrifying Gaze. Source does not specify how this interacts with the start-of-turn trigger.

No additional Toxic Cloud or automatic poisoned condition has been added.

STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Gahgah Yagha, The Tenebrous Troll

Huge Fiend (Hag), chaotic evil

AC 16 (natural armor). HP 325 (22d10 + 198). Speed 40 ft.

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
26 (+8) 14 (+2) 28 (+9) 14 (+2) 16 (+4), as supplied 20 (+5)

Saves: Str +14, Dex +8, Con +15, Int +8, Wis +10, Cha +11.

Skills: Athletics +14, Deception +17, Perception +10, Persuasion +11.

Damage Resistance: Fire, Necrotic, Radiant; Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks. Damage Immunities: Cold, Poison. Condition Immunities: Charmed, Poisoned.

Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19. Languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Giant, Infernal. Challenge: 18.

Innate Spellcasting. No material components. At will: detect magic, mage hand, minor illusion. 3/day each: darkness, fear, misty step. 1/day each: cloudkill, cone of cold, teleport. Source omission: spellcasting ability and DC not stated.

Regeneration. Regains 20 HP at the start of her turn. Acid damage prevents this at the start of her next turn. Dies only if starting her turn with 0 HP and not regenerating.

Two Heads. Advantage on Perception and saves against Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and being knocked unconscious.

Spell Resistance. Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions

The supplied action heading contains the fragment 'attack.' No standard-turn Multiattack was specified here.

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 feet; 21 (2d12 + 8) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison.

Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 feet; 17 (2d10 + 8) slashing damage. On hit the target is Grappled, escape DC 15. Until escape it is Restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and saves.

Fling. Hurls a grappled creature up to 60 feet in any direction; 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and Prone. If it collides with an object or creature, add 7 (2d6) bludgeoning for each 10 feet thrown beyond the first 10 feet.

Legendary actions

Three per round, at the end of others' turns, refreshed at the start of her turn. Costs not explicitly written are left as supplied and audited separately.

Multiattack. Two claw or bite attacks.

Enraging Howl (2). Creatures within 30 feet make DC 18 Wisdom saves or become enraged and attack the nearest creature, friend or foe, until the end of their next turn. If attacked, a creature can repeat the save at the end of its turn.

Regeneration (2). Regains 20 HP at the start of her turn for 1 minute.

Stunning Slamalam. A melee head attack attempting to stun; target makes DC 18 Constitution save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn. Source omission: attack bonus and damage not specified.

Flying Headbutt (2). Melee head attack against a Large or smaller creature; on hit it takes damage 'as normal' and makes DC 18 Strength save or falls Prone and is pushed 10 feet. Source omission: the head attack's base damage is not defined.

Mounted

One with the tarrasque. +5 AC while riding Gargantua and may use Gargantua's abilities while riding it.

Regeneration. While she rides Gargantua, it regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 HP.

Gargantua: a tarrasque mount was named, but its own statistics were not supplied.
